lines.text: Grace tied her hair up for the climb and pulled a beanie over the top.
It kept riding up, and the wind found her ears.
She finally stuffed it in her pocket.
Wear a fleece ear warmer headband.
It sits under the ponytail, covers your ears and forehead, and stays put.
The top of your head can still let out heat on the climb.
Save this before your next cold hike.
